clues.text: At the burning bush, God told Moses to take these off because he stood on holy ground.
On the first Passover night in Egypt, Israel ate dressed for travel, with these on their feet.
John the Baptist said he was not worthy to untie the straps of these on the One coming after him.
When the lost son came home, his father called for the best robe, a ring, and these for his feet.
In Herod's prison, an angel woke Peter and told him to get dressed and put these on.
The Gibeonites fooled Joshua by wearing worn, patched ones, pretending they came from a distant land.
Moses told Israel that in forty years in the wilderness, neither their clothes nor these wore out.
